# function: dataexchange_entitled_assets

Builds the ARN of an `dataexchange` `entitled-assets`:

```
arn:${Partition}:dataexchange:${Region}::data-sets/${DataSetId}/revisions/${RevisionId}/assets/${AssetId}
```

`${Partition}`, `${Region}` and `${Account}` come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.



## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
dataexchange_entitled_assets(data_set_id string, revision_id string, asset_id string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `data_set_id` (String) Value for `${DataSetId}` in the ARN template.
1. `revision_id` (String) Value for `${RevisionId}` in the ARN template.
1. `asset_id` (String) Value for `${AssetId}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given.
